---
title: "תכנית הוראה מפורטת תשפ״ו"
toc: true
toc-title: "יחידות הקורס"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-schedule
#| include: false
schedule <- read_csv(
  "datasets/schedule/schedule_2026.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

תכנית הקורס מאורגנת לארבע יחידות עיקריות. לחצו על כותרת יחידה לפרטים נוספים.
בכל שיעור מופיעה (כאשר רלוונטית) **מחברת Python** לתרגול מעשי.

---

```{r}
#| label: render-schedule
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

units <- schedule |> 
  select(unit_number, unit_name) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  arrange(unit_number)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(units))) {
  u_num  <- units$unit_number[i]
  u_name <- units$unit_name[i]
  
  cat(sprintf("\n## יחידה %s: %s\n\n", u_num, u_name))
  
  unit_rows <- schedule |> 
    filter(unit_number == u_num) |> 
    mutate(
      # Wrap date in LTR span
      date = sprintf('<span dir="ltr">%s</span>', date),
      # Link topic to slides URL (opens in new tab) when present
      topic = ifelse(
        !is.na(slides_url) & slides_url != "",
        sprintf('%s <a href="%s" target="_blank" title="שקפי השיעור">🖥️</a>', topic, slides_url),
        topic
      ),
      # Extract notebook number from filename (e.g. "05_AI..." -> 5)
      notebook_num = as.integer(str_extract(notebook, "^\\d+")),
      # Format notebook as badge link if present
      notebook_col = ifelse(
        !is.na(notebook) & notebook != "",
        sprintf('<a href="notebooks/index.html#nb%s" class="notebook-badge">📓 מחברת %s</a>', notebook_num, notebook_num),
        ""
      )
    ) |>
    select(
      `תאריך`   = date,
      `נושא`    = topic,
      `מחברת`   = notebook_col,
      `פעילות`  = activity,
      `קריאה`   = reading
    )
  
  # Replace NA with empty string
  unit_rows[is.na(unit_rows)] <- ""
  
  tbl <- knitr::kable(
    unit_rows,
    format    = "html",
    escape    = FALSE,
    table.attr = 'class="schedule-table table table-striped table-hover" dir="rtl"'
  )
  cat(tbl)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
